integrity: The proof derives the exact Euclidean facet distances after unequal diagonal lecture-hall scaling, converts every ball-containment condition to an augmented-Hasse edge inequality, and proves both the upper bound and sharpness through longest-path dual constructions. The complete center set and uniqueness criterion follow from matching prefix and suffix path bounds. Finite computations are used only for corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for naturally labeled finite posets, positive integer lecture-hall parameters, and the canonical standard-Euclidean realization. It does not cover partially open non-natural-label variants or other norms. The unweighted ordinary order-polytope case is a strict prior special case, and a residual risk remains that a general difference-constraint Chebyshev-center theorem could subsume the weighted dynamic-programming argument.
title: Euclidean inradius of every lecture-hall order polytope is a weighted critical-path reciprocal
